in_arabic.name: मوسى
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإسم مُشتق من اللفظ المقدس في اللغة العربية، ويُمثل المُقدّس المُبارَك المُبارَك في الإسلام. وَمَصدر الإسم يعود إلى الاسم الإلهي الذي يُنفرد به الرب في الإسلام، وَيُشير إلى المُقدّس الذي يُعد المُبارَك في العُلا، كما يُشير إلى القَرم الذي يُصلى به العُمرة. ويُستخدم الإسم في القرآن الكريم، ويُعد من الأسماء المُقدسة في الإسلام. وَيُمثل المُصطفى المُبارَك الذي أُرسِلَ لِلمُؤمِنينَ، ويُشير إلى المُقدّس الذي يُعد المُبارَك في العُلا.

in_pashto.long_meaning: سمه د اسلامي اصطلاح کې د مقدس، مبارک، مبارکې د معناښی ده، چې د الله تعالیٰ سره تړاو لري. دا سمه د مسلمانو ستر نومونو پورې تړاو لري، چې د اسلامي تاریخ کې د مسلمانو لپاره ډېر ځلونه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Mosa
in_english.meaning: The name Mosa means holy, blessed, blessed, and represents divine grace
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mosa is derived from the Arabic root word for holy, blessed, and blessed, and represents divine grace in Islam. It is used in the Quran and is considered one of the most sacred names in Islam. The name Mosa is also associated with the biblical figure Moses, who is considered a prophet in Islam. In Arabic, the name Mosa is written as موسي and is pronounced as MOO-see. The name Mosa is popular among Muslims around the world and is often given to children born into Muslim families.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mosa holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic communities as it is the name of one of the most revered Prophets in the Quran. Prophet Musa (Moses) is considered an important figure in Islamic history and is respected for his leadership, courage, and faith. His story of rescue from the Nile river, guidance from Allah, and encounter with Pharaoh are included in the Islamic faith's holy text, the Quran.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Mosa signifies God's mercy and compassion towards His creation, as He saved the Prophet from a watery grave and raised him up as a leader and guide for his people. Musa's story serves as an example of faith and perseverance, as he remained steadfast in his belief in Allah, despite facing numerous trials and challenges throughout his life. The name Mosa is also a reminder of Allah's ability to bring forth great leaders and guides from the most unexpected circumstances. Overall, it is a source of inspiration and guidance for those who bear the name and for all believers of Islam.
